title: The derived couple of an exact couple is exact
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $s\geq0$ an integer. An *exact couple of type $s$* $(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ in $\mathcal A$ consists of objects $D^{p,q},E^{p,q}$ ($p,q\in\mathbf Z$) and morphisms $\alpha:D^{p,q}\to D^{p-1,q+1}$, $f:E^{p,q}\to D^{p+2,q-1}$, $g:D^{p,q}\to E^{p+s,q-s}$ such that at every $(p,q)$ the three sequences
$$E^{p-2,q+1}\xrightarrow{f}D^{p,q}\xrightarrow{\alpha}D^{p-1,q+1},\qquad D^{p-s,q+s}\xrightarrow{g}E^{p,q}\xrightarrow{f}D^{p+2,q-1},\qquad D^{p+1,q-1}\xrightarrow{\alpha}D^{p,q}\xrightarrow{g}E^{p+s,q-s}$$
are complexes and exact in the middle (the kernel of each arrow is the image of its predecessor). Type $0$ is the exact couple of [def-sp-exact-couple]. Put $d=g\circ f:E^{p,q}\to E^{p+s+2,q-s-1}$. The *derived couple* $(D',E',\alpha',f',g')$ is: $D'^{p,q}=\operatorname{im}(\alpha:D^{p+1,q-1}\to D^{p,q})$, with inclusion $\iota:D'^{p,q}\hookrightarrow D^{p,q}$ and epimorphism $\bar\alpha:D^{p+1,q-1}\twoheadrightarrow D'^{p,q}$, $\iota\circ\bar\alpha=\alpha$; $E'^{p,q}=\ker(d:E^{p,q}\to E^{p+s+2,q-s-1})/\operatorname{im}(d:E^{p-s-2,q+s+1}\to E^{p,q})$ with projection $\pi$; $\alpha':D'^{p,q}\to D'^{p-1,q+1}$ the unique map with $\iota\circ\alpha'=\alpha\circ\iota$; $f':E'^{p,q}\to D'^{p+2,q-1}$ the unique map with $\iota\circ f'\circ\pi=f|_{\ker d}$; $g':D'^{p,q}\to E'^{p+s+1,q-s-1}$ the unique map with $g'\circ\bar\alpha=\pi\circ\hat g$, where $\hat g:D^{p+1,q-1}\to\ker(d)\subseteq E^{p+s+1,q-s-1}$ is the factorization of $g$. Then:

1. $\ker(d:E^{p,q}\to E^{p+s+2,q-s-1})=f^{-1}(\ker g)=f^{-1}(\operatorname{im}\alpha)$, with $\ker g=\operatorname{im}\alpha\subseteq D^{p+2,q-1}$, and $\operatorname{im}(d:E^{p-s-2,q+s+1}\to E^{p,q})=g(\operatorname{im}f)=g(\ker\alpha)$, with $\operatorname{im}f=\ker\alpha\subseteq D^{p-s,q+s}$ (equalities of subobjects of $E^{p,q}$; $f^{-1}$ is the pullback of a subobject, $g(S)$ the image of $S\hookrightarrow D\xrightarrow{g}E$).
2. The maps $\alpha',f',g'$ exist and are unique as stated (in particular $d\circ d=0$, $f(\ker d)\subseteq\operatorname{im}\alpha$, $g$ factors through $\ker d$, and $\pi\circ\hat g$ vanishes on $\ker\bar\alpha$).
3. The derived couple is an exact couple of type $s+1$: $\alpha'$ has bidegree $(-1,+1)$, $f'$ bidegree $(+2,-1)$, $g'$ bidegree $(s+1,-s-1)$, and its three sequences are complexes, exact in the middle.
4. (Iteration, Stacks 011S.) For an exact couple $C=(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ of [def-sp-exact-couple] put $C_2=C$ and $C_{r+1}=C_r'$. Then $C_r=(D_r,E_r,\alpha_r,f_r,g_r)$ is an exact couple of type $r-2$ for all $r\geq2$; $D_r^{p,q}=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^{r-2}:D^{p+r-2,q-r+2}\to D^{p,q})$ as a subobject of $D^{p,q}$, $\alpha_r$ is the restriction of $\alpha$, $f_r$ has bidegree $(+2,-1)$, $g_r$ bidegree $(r-2,2-r)$, $d_r=g_r\circ f_r$ bidegree $(r,1-r)$, and $E_{r+1}^{p,q}=\ker(d_r\text{ out of }E_r^{p,q})/\operatorname{im}(d_r\text{ into }E_r^{p,q})$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sp-derived-couple-kernel-identities] for the seven kernel/image clauses. Apply [lem-sp-derived-couple-map-uniqueness] to obtain the induced maps and the three uniqueness clauses. Apply [lem-sp-derived-couple-boundary-vanishes] for vanishing of the incoming alpha kernel in the cycle quotient.

The defining kernel lift of gToCycles gives its factorization equation by simplification. The d_comp_d theorem of [def-sp-exact-couple] supplies the differential-square-zero clause. Assemble these with the preceding helper theorems into derived_couple_exact. The old generalized-element argument now belongs to the imported helper nodes.

Step 11 (iteration). Apply [lem-sp-derived-couple-image-prefix] for the explicitly constructed alpha-power and inclusion families, their recurrences, monicity, equal image subobjects, and alpha compatibility. The next E object is definitionally the cokernel of the incoming differential lifted into the outgoing kernel, by pageCouple and derivedE in [def-sp-exact-couple]. The bidegrees are recorded in the types of pageCouple and its maps.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks homology.tex Section 12.21 (Lemma 011R, proof omitted; Definitions 011Q, 011S; Lemma 011T; Remark 0AMJ with its footnote) and Section 12.5 (Lemmas 08N5, 05PK, 010C). Statement generalized from the type-0 couple of def-sp-exact-couple to an exact couple of type s (g of bidegree (s,-s)), which the iteration needs: the derived couple of a type-0 couple has g' of bidegree (1,-1), so the induction for C_r runs over types r-2; for s=0 the statement is the old one. Claims stated as before (ker d, im d, well-definedness of alpha', f', g', exactness of the derived couple, D_r = im alpha^{r-2}, bidegrees). Proof written in 12 steps: element calculus with elements T -> X up to epimorphic refinement (Stacks 011T/08N5; Mathlib Refinements.lean, new Mathlib-leaf node lem-sp-abelian-refinements), d o d = 0, the two subobject identities, the three constructions by universal properties (epi = cokernel of its kernel, def-sp-abelian), the three exactness chases, assembly, and the induction on r. No Freyd-Mitchell; differences of elements are differences in Hom(T,X). Proof is agent-written (Stacks omits it). Searches: the item's earlier five plus leansearch, leanfinder and grep; Mathlib has no exact couples.

lean.statement: theorem derived_couple_exact {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] {s : ℕ} (X : BigradedExactCouple C s) : (∀ p q : ℤ, let a : X.D (p + 3) (q - 2) ⟶ X.D (p + 2) (q - 1) := X.alpha (p + 3) (q - 2) ≫ eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega) kernelSubobject (X.d p q) = (Subobject.pullback (X.f p q)).obj (kernelSubobject (X.g (p + 2) (q - 1))) ∧ kernelSubobject (X.d p q) = (Subobject.pullback (X.f p q)).obj (imageSubobject a) ∧ kernelSubobject (X.g (p + 2) (q - 1)) = imageSubobject a ∧ imageSubobject (X.d p q) = imageSubobject ((imageSubobject (X.f p q)).arrow ≫ X.g (p + 2) (q - 1)) ∧ imageSubobject (X.d p q) = imageSubobject ((kernelSubobject (X.alpha (p + 2) (q - 1))).arrow ≫ X.g (p + 2) (q - 1)) ∧ imageSubobject (X.f p q) = kernelSubobject (X.alpha (p + 2) (q - 1)) ∧ imageSubobject (kernel.ι (X.d p q) ≫ X.f p q) ≤ imageSubobject a) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, X.gToCycles p q ≫ kernel.ι (X.d (p + s) (q - s)) = X.g p q) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, X.d p q ≫ X.d (p + 2 + s) (q - 1 - s) = 0) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, kernel.ι (factorThruImage (X.alpha (p + 1) (q - 1))) ≫ X.gToCycles (p + 1) (q - 1) ≫ X.derivedEProjection ((p + 1) + s) ((q - 1) - s) = 0) ∧ (∃ M : DerivedMaps X, (∀ (p q : ℤ) (a : X.derivedD p q ⟶ X.derivedD (p - 1) (q + 1)), a ≫ X.derivedDInclusion (p - 1) (q + 1) = X.derivedDInclusion p q ≫ X.alpha p q → a = M.alpha p q) ∧ (∀ (p q : ℤ) (b : X.derivedE p q ⟶ X.derivedD (p + 2) (q - 1)), X.derivedEProjection p q ≫ b ≫ X.derivedDInclusion (p + 2) (q - 1) = kernel.ι (X.d p q) ≫ X.f p q → b = M.f p q) ∧ (∀ (p q : ℤ) (c : X.derivedD p q ⟶ X.derivedE (p + (s + 1)) (q - (s + 1))), factorThruImage (X.alpha (p + 1) (q - 1)) ≫ c = X.gToCycles (p + 1) (q - 1) ≫ X.derivedEProjection ((p + 1) + s) ((q - 1) - s) ≫ eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega) → c = M.g p q))
lean.note: Clauses 1–3 are stated by derived_couple_exact; clause 4 by pageCouple_image. The latter uses n = r - 2, tracking powers and canonical inclusions by their defining recurrences.
